# (-1,1)-Sumplete

(-1,1)-Sumplete
Input file: standard input
Output file: standard output
Time limit: 3 seconds
Memory limit: 1024 megabytes
Sumplete is a logic puzzle similar to Sudoku, Kakuro, and Hitori. It is famous for being developed with
the help of 1ChatGPT.
The Sumplete puzzle consists of a square grid, with each cell containing an integer. Each row and column
also has an integer “hint” assigned. The player must cross out some numbers in the grid such that the sum
of uncrossed numbers in each row and column equals the corresponding hint. See the following picture for
an illustration.
An example of a 5 × 5 Sumplete puzzle (left) and its solution (right)
Recently, on September 15th, 2023, a paper Sumplete is Hard, Even with Two Different Numbers by
Suthee Ruangwises was uploaded to 2arxiv. The paper showed that if we allow the grid of Sumplete
puzzles to be rectangular, then deciding the solvability of a given Sumplete puzzle is NP-complete, even
if the grid contains only two different numbers 1 and 3.
Bobo is quite unsatisfied with this result. He insists that there must exist some Sumplete puzzles that are
easy to solve. Now he provides you with a Sumplete puzzle, where the grid contains only two different
numbers −1 and 1. Can you please solve the puzzle for him?
Input
The first line of input contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 4 000), denoting the height and width of the grid of
the Sumplete puzzle.
Then n lines follow, where the i-th (1 ≤ i ≤ n) line contains a string si of length n consisting of ’+‘s and
‘−’s, such that ai,j = 1 if the j-th character of si
is ‘+’ and ai,j = −1 if the j-th character of si
is ‘−’.
The input then contains a line containing n integers r1, r2, . . . , rn (−n ≤ ri ≤ n), where the i-th number
denotes the hint in the i-th row.
Lastly, the input contains a line containing n integers c1, c2, . . . , cn (−n ≤ ci ≤ n), where the i-th number
denotes the hint in the i-th column.
Output
If the given Sumplete puzzle has no solutions, output “No” in the first line. Otherwise, output “Yes” in
the first line. You can output each letter in any case (lowercase or uppercase). For example, the strings
“yEs”, “yes”, “Yes”, and “YES” will all be considered as positive replies.
1See https://sumplete.com/about/ to learn more about the creation of this puzzle.
2
https://arxiv.org/pdf/2309.07161.pdf
Page 1 of 2

If your answer is “Yes”, output a binary string of length n in each of the following n lines. In the i-th
(1 ≤ i ≤ n) line you need to output a string ti of length n consisting of ’0‘s and ‘1’s, such that the j-th
character of ti being ‘0’ denotes you cross out the number on the i-th row and j-th column, and the
j-th character of ti being ‘1’ denotes you keep it. Your solution must satisfy that the sum of uncrossed
numbers in each row and column equals the corresponding hint. If there are multiple solutions, outputting
any of them will be considered correct.
Examples
standard input standard output
3
+-+
-++
+-+
1 1 1
1 -1 3
Yes
111
001
001
3
---
-++
+++
-2 -1 0
-2 -1 0
Yes
110
100
000
3
+-+
-++
++-
1 0 2
2 2 -1
No
Note
The first sample corresponds to the following 3 × 3 Sumplete puzzle:
Its three solutions are listed as follows (the third one corresponds to crossing out none of the numbers in
the grid), and outputting any of them will be considered correct.
Page 2 of 2

[PDF](https://codeforces.com/gym/104891/problem/A)

# (-1,1)-Sumplete

Time limit: $3$ seconds. Memory limit: $1024$ MB. Standard input and standard output.

Sumplete is a logic puzzle similar to Sudoku, Kakuro, and Hitori, known for being developed with the help of ChatGPT [1].

A Sumplete puzzle is a square grid of integers, with an integer hint for every row and column. Cross out some entries so that the sum of the remaining entries in every row and column equals its hint.

![diagram](sumplete-introduction.png)

The figure shows a $5\times5$ puzzle on the left and a solution on the right.

On $2023$-$9$-$15$, Suthee Ruangwises uploaded the paper `Sumplete is Hard, Even with Two Different Numbers` to arXiv [2]. It proves that, if rectangular grids are allowed, deciding whether a Sumplete puzzle is solvable is NP-complete even when the grid uses only $1$ and $3$.

Bobo is dissatisfied: surely some Sumplete puzzles must be easy to solve. He gives you a square puzzle whose entries are only $-1$ and $1$. Solve it for him.

## Input

The first line contains $n$ ($1\leq n\leq4000$), the height and width of the grid.

Each of the next $n$ lines contains a string $s_i$ of length $n$, consisting of `+` and `-`. Entry $a_{i,j}=1$ when the $j$-th character of $s_i$ is `+`, and $a_{i,j}=-1$ when it is `-`.

The next line contains $n$ integers $r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_n$ ($-n\leq r_i\leq n$), the row hints.

The final line contains $n$ integers $c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_n$ ($-n\leq c_i\leq n$), the column hints.

## Output

If there is no solution, print `No` on the first line. Otherwise, print `Yes`. Letter case does not matter: for example, `yEs`, `yes`, `Yes`, and `YES` are all accepted affirmative answers.

After an affirmative answer, output $n$ binary strings of length $n$. In string $t_i$, the $j$-th character `0` means to cross out entry $(i,j)$, and `1` means to keep it. Every row and column sum of the kept entries must equal its hint. Any valid solution is accepted.

## Note

The first sample is the following $3\times3$ puzzle:

![diagram](sumplete-first-sample.png)

Its three solutions are shown below. The third keeps every entry. Any of them is accepted.

![diagram](sumplete-three-solutions.png)

## References

[1] About the puzzle's creation: https://sumplete.com/about/

[2] The paper: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2309.07161.pdf

# (-1,1)-Sumplete

来源：[原赛题目](https://codeforces.com/gym/104891/problem/A)、[完整原赛题册](https://contest.ucup.ac/download.php?id=1459&r=0&type=attachments)。以下用中文整理原题的完整规则、输入输出与全部数据范围；原题册保留原文及原图。

## 题目描述

给定一个 $n\times n$ 的方阵，每格的数只能为 $-1$ 或 $1$。每行有一个目标和 $r_i$，每列有一个目标和 $c_j$。

可以划掉任意一些格子，要求每一行未划掉的数之和恰好等于该行目标，每一列未划掉的数之和恰好等于该列目标。判断是否有解；有解时给出一个保留方案。

## 输入格式

第一行输入 $1\le n\le4000$。随后 $n$ 行，每行一个长度为 $n$、仅含加号与减号的字符串，分别表示对应格子为正一、负一。接着一行输入 $n$ 个行目标 $r_1,\ldots,r_n$；最后一行输入 $n$ 个列目标 $c_1,\ldots,c_n$，所有目标都介于 $-n$ 与 $n$。

## 输出格式

无解输出 No。有解先输出 Yes，随后输出 $n$ 个长度为 $n$ 的二进制字符串：一表示保留，零表示划掉。若有多个答案，任意合法方案均可。Yes、No 不区分字母大小写。

# (-1,1)-Sumplete

时间限制：$3$ 秒。内存限制：$1024$ MB。使用标准输入和标准输出。

Sumplete 是一种类似数独、Kakuro 和 Hitori 的逻辑谜题，因借助 ChatGPT 开发而闻名 [1]。

Sumplete 谜题由一个整数方阵组成，每行和每列都有一个整数提示数。玩家需要划掉部分格子，使每行、每列剩余格子中的数字之和都等于对应的提示数。

![diagram](sumplete-introduction.png)

上图左侧是一个 $5\times5$ 的谜题，右侧是它的一种解。

$2023$ 年 $9$ 月 $15$ 日，Suthee Ruangwises 在 arXiv 上发布了论文 `Sumplete is Hard, Even with Two Different Numbers` [2]。论文证明：如果允许使用矩形网格，那么即使格子中只有 $1$ 和 $3$ 两种数字，判断一个 Sumplete 谜题是否有解仍是 NP 完全问题。

Bobo 对这个结果并不满意：总该有一些容易解决的 Sumplete 谜题。他现在给你一个方阵谜题，格子里只有 $-1$ 和 $1$ 两种数字，请你帮他求解。

## 输入

第一行包含整数 $n$（$1\leq n\leq4000$），表示方阵的行数和列数。

接下来 $n$ 行，每行包含一个长度为 $n$、由 `+` 和 `-` 组成的字符串 $s_i$。若 $s_i$ 的第 $j$ 个字符为 `+`，则 $a_{i,j}=1$；若为 `-`，则 $a_{i,j}=-1$。

下一行包含 $n$ 个整数 $r_1,r_2,\ldots,r_n$（$-n\leq r_i\leq n$），表示各行的提示数。

最后一行包含 $n$ 个整数 $c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_n$（$-n\leq c_i\leq n$），表示各列的提示数。

## 输出

如果谜题无解，第一行输出 `No`；否则输出 `Yes`。字母大小写不限，例如 `yEs`、`yes`、`Yes`、`YES` 都会被视为肯定回答。

如果回答有解，接下来输出 $n$ 个长度为 $n$ 的二进制串。字符串 $t_i$ 的第 $j$ 个字符为 `0`，表示划掉格子 $(i,j)$；为 `1`，表示保留该格子。保留格子中的数字，必须使每行、每列的和都等于对应提示数。若有多个解，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

第一组样例对应以下 $3\times3$ 谜题：

![diagram](sumplete-first-sample.png)

它的三种解如下所示，其中第三种解没有划掉任何数字。输出其中任意一种都能被接受。

![diagram](sumplete-three-solutions.png)

## 参考资料

[1] 关于这个谜题的开发经过：https://sumplete.com/about/

[2] 论文链接：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2309.07161.pdf
